summary: BUG: Cannot send invoice email if Customer Email is missing
reported_issue: Inferred (no explicit STR): the invoice could not be sent by email when the customer/contact had no email address on file - sending was blocked or failed.
expected_after_fix: User can send the invoice email even when the customer email is missing (e.g. by entering a recipient manually); sending is not blocked.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened an invoiced Work Order Finance tab and clicked Send Email.
In the 'Sending invoice' dialog, UNCHECKED the customer/contact recipient so that no customer email would be used.
Entered a manual address in the 'Optional Emails (Comma Separated)' field only.
Verified the Send Email button state and clicked it, capturing the response.
actual_now: With the contact recipient unchecked (simulating a missing customer email) and only a manually entered optional email, the Send Email button remained ENABLED and the send succeeded: POST /api/work-order/invoice/send-email returned HTTP 201 with a 'Successfully sent invoice to email.' toast and the dialog closed. The dialog also exposes an 'Optional Emails' field so a recipient can always be provided.
notes: Ticket had no usable repro; inferred from summary. A missing customer email no longer blocks sending - the invoice can be emailed to a manually supplied address. All existing invoiced test WOs happened to have contact emails, so the missing-email condition was reproduced by unchecking the contact and relying solely on the Optional Emails field.
